integrity: Analytical proof, finite exact-path checks and exact benchmark. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only exactly solved independent one-way subflows of a two-state generator are classified.
The invariant random probability vector must not be confused with a sample path of the underlying continuous-time Markov chain.
No absolute-continuity or dimension conclusion is asserted for overlapping Bernoulli-convolution parameter q>1/2.
Claimed scheme-specific originality remains subject to specialist publication precedence.
title: Unique mean-exact calibration and a Cantor stationary law for randomized two-state generator splitting
